control_profile: Volatility-target only: a no-leverage twenty-two-percent annualized target with no drawdown brake, position stop, time stop, or turnover throttle.
falsifier: The isolated volatility target makes either 2022 or 2024H1 negative after doubled costs, reduces the positive-fold count below four, or pushes gross edge below fifty basis points per turnover.

hypothesis: The no-leverage volatility target is the least intrusive overlay and should preserve the controls-off signal's five-fold breadth while reducing exposure only when trailing portfolio volatility exceeds twenty-two percent.
